Alright, we've got everything Filecia asked us to\ncollect. Now we just need to hand it over to\nher...Huh?
Sheesh...I was worried sick since that scary girl\nwas there too, gob.
By the way, do you know what Adonius has been\ndoing, gob? This was originally his plan, right,\ngob?
Yeah, he's kinda stuck right now...\nBut hey, good job getting those sweets from that\ngirl.
Ugh! What's this?!
*Cough, cough*\n...?! My body doesn't feel right, gob...!!
We were worried because you were taking so long,\nso we decided to come look for you.\nW-what's going on here...?!
Wait, what's happening?!
The sweets that girl makes seem to have a special\neffect on living things, so I made a potion to\ndouble the effect.
Tee hee hee...Just as I thought, it seems that\nas long as the substance remains, even if it's\njust a tiny amount, it still works!
W-what are you talking about?!
Just as that old man said, the sweets you make\nseem to hold a special power...
Because of that, you're being targeted by the\norganization that wants to abuse it.
What? Me?
Yes. And Lefina, you have the power to counter it.\nWith this potion I made using your sweets...
W-what has happened to my appearance?!
This is your ultimate form that unleashed the\npower of your sweets...Now, let's fight that evil\norganization together!
Hahahaha! So you wanna help me with my experiment!\nFine, I'll use you to find out how powerful these\nguys have become!
Lefina! Let's fight those three little ones\ntogether! As for the big one, we'll leave it to\nyou and Pelulu!
O-okay!
Alright, you take care of it!
What...?! So the effect wasn't strong enough!\nBut it's okay. It's still good since I managed to\nfigure out this much!
Eh...? W-what happened, gob?
Huh?
Oh! The scary girl!
Run, gob!!
It seems that we're free from danger now...\nLet's go back to our normal form.
I, I never knew I had that kind of power...
Just like what happened today, evil organizations\nseem to be targeting you to abuse your power.
If possible, from now on, I want you to get me\ninvolved in everything you do...
I, I can protect myself!\nBut...if you insist, and if it's just once in a\nwhile, I might consider it.
Yes, that will do for now...And thank you very\nmuch for your help. Here is the reward for you and\nPelulu...
